variants.name: Customizing Dragons
variants.descriptionHtml:
You can customize any dragon's stat block to reflect the dragon's unique character. Minor changes such as those below are easy to make and have no impact on a dragon's challenge rating.

Languages.

Most dragons prefer to speak Draconic but learn Common for dealing with allies and minions. But given their high Intelligence and long life span, dragons can easily learn additional languages. You can add languages to a dragon's stat block.

Skills.

Most dragons are proficient in the Perception and Stealth skills, and many dragons have additional skill proficiencies. As with languages, you can customize a dragon's skill list (even doubling their proficiency bonus with certain skills) to reflect particular interests and activities. You can also give a dragon tool proficiencies, particularly if the dragon spends time in Humanoid form.

Spells.

See the "Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters" inset(s), below.

Other Traits and Actions.

You can borrow traits and actions from other monsters to add unique flavor to a dragon. Consider these examples:

  • Damage Absorption.

    You might decide that this dragon is not only unharmed by fire damage, but actually healed by it.

    Whenever the dragon is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

  • Flyby.

    The dragon is an agile flier, quick to fly out of enemies' reach.

    The dragon doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

  • Mimicry.

    Impersonating characters or their allies could be a fun trick for a crafty dragon.

    The dragon can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.

  • Rejuvenation.

    You might decide that dragons in your campaign, being an essential part of the Material Plane, are nearly impossible to destroy. A dragon's life essence might be preserved in the egg from which it first emerged, in its hoard, or in a cavernous hall at the center of the world, just as a lich's essence is hidden in a phylactery.

    If it has an essence-preserving object, a destroyed dragon gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the object.

  • Special Senses.

    Most dragons have blindsight and darkvision. You might upgrade blindsight to truesight, or you could give a dragon with a burrowing speed tremorsense.

items.entry: The fey can force one creature it can see within 10 feet of it to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. Unless the save succeeds, the target is {@condition charmed} by you and the fey for 1 minute or until the target takes any damage.

items.name: Tricksy
items.entry: The fey can fill a 5-foot cube within 5 feet of it with magical darkness, which lasts until the end of its next turn.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: The fiend has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
entries: The fiend has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Death Throes (Demon Only)
traits.descriptionHtml: When the fiend drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends, the fiend explodes, and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. A creature takes 2d10 + summonSpellLevel fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries: When the fiend drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends, the fiend explodes, and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. A creature takes {@damage 2d10 + summonSpellLevel} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Devil's Sight (Devil Only)
traits.descriptionHtml: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fiend's darkvision.
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fiend's darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The fiend makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).
entries: The fiend makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Bite (Demon Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d12 + 3 + summonSpellLevel necrotic damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d12 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claws (Yugoloth Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel slashing damage. Immediately after the attack hits or misses, the fiend can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} slashing damage. Immediately after the attack hits or misses, the fiend can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Hurl Flame (Devil Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Spell Attack: {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.
entries: {@atk rs} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 150 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.descriptionHtml: If the homunculus is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it's incapacitated.
entries: If the homunculus is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it's {@condition incapacitated}.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Weapon Attack: {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 30 ft., one target you can see. Hit: 1d4 + PB force damage.
entries: {@atk rw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 30 ft., one target you can see. {@h}{@damage 1d4 + PB} force damage.

reactions.name: Channel Magic
reactions.descriptionHtml: The homunculus delivers a spell you cast that has a range of touch. The homunculus must be within 120 feet of you.
entries: The homunculus delivers a spell you cast that has a range of touch. The homunculus must be within 120 feet of you.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.descriptionHtml: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.descriptionHtml: The mimic can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
entries: The mimic can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.descriptionHtml: The mimic polymorphs into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
entries: The mimic polymorphs into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

name: Mighty Servant of Leuk-o
languages: understands the languages of creatures attuned to it but can't speak

traits.name: Immutable Existence
traits.descriptionHtml: The servant is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form or send it to another plane of existence.
entries: The servant is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form or send it to another plane of existence.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: The servant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attacks made against it have disadvantage.
entries: The servant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attacks made against it have disadvantage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.descriptionHtml: The servant regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If it is reduced to 0 hit points, this trait doesn't function until an attuned creature spends 24 hours repairing the artifact or until the artifact is subjected to lightning damage.
entries: The servant regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If it is reduced to 0 hit points, this trait doesn't function until an attuned creature spends 24 hours repairing the artifact or until the artifact is subjected to lightning damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.descriptionHtml: The servant's long jump is up to 50 feet and its high jump is up to 25 feet, with or without a running start.
entries: The servant's long jump is up to 50 feet and its high jump is up to 25 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.descriptionHtml: The servant doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.
entries: The servant doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Destructive Fist
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage. Or Ranged Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage. If the target is an object, it takes triple damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) force damage. Or Ranged Weapon Attack: {@hit 17} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) force damage. If the target is an object, it takes triple damage.

actions.name: Crushing Leap
actions.descriptionHtml: If the servant jumps at least 25 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures is pushed to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the servant and must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 26 (4d12) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.
entries: If the servant jumps at least 25 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures is pushed to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the servant and must make a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 26 ({@damage 4d12}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.descriptionHtml: The reflection can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
entries: The reflection can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.descriptionHtml: While in dim light or darkness, the reflection can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Its stealth bonus is also improved to +6.
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the reflection can take the {@action Hide} action as a bonus action. Its stealth bonus is also improved to +6.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.descriptionHtml: While in sunlight, the reflection has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.
entries: While in sunlight, the reflection has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.descriptionHtml:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new reflection rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.
If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new {@creature reflection} rises from the corpse {@dice 1d4} hours later.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Terror Frenzy (Fury Only)
traits.descriptionHtml: The spirit has advantage on attack rolls against frightened creatures.
entries: The spirit has advantage on attack rolls against {@condition frightened} creatures.

traits.name: Weight of Sorrow (Despair Only)
traits.descriptionHtml: Any creature, other than you, that starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit has its speed reduced by 20 feet until the start of that creature's next turn.
entries: Any creature, other than you, that starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit has its speed reduced by 20 feet until the start of that creature's next turn.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d12 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} cold damage.

actions.name: Dreadful Scream (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The spirit screams. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be frightened for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
entries: The spirit screams. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth (Fear Only)
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: While in dim light or darkness, the spirit takes the Hide action.
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the spirit takes the {@action Hide} action.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Vigilant
traits.descriptionHtml: The defender can't be surprised.
entries: The defender can't be {@status surprised}.

actions.name: Force-Empowered Rend
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target you can see. Hit: 1d8 + PB force damage.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target you can see. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + PB} force damage.

actions.name: Repair (3/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The magical mechanisms inside the defender restore 2d8 + PB hit points to itself or to one construct or object within 5 feet of it.
entries: The magical mechanisms inside the defender restore {@dice 2d8 + PB} hit points to itself or to one construct or object within 5 feet of it.

reactions.name: Deflect Attack
reactions.descriptionHtml: The defender imposes disadvantage on the attack roll of one creature it can see that is within 5 feet of it, provided the attack roll is against a creature other than the defender.
entries: The defender imposes disadvantage on the attack roll of one creature it can see that is within 5 feet of it, provided the attack roll is against a creature other than the defender.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Incorporeal Passage (Ghostly Only)
traits.descriptionHtml: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 force damage for every 5 feet traveled.
entries: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes {@damage 1d10} force damage for every 5 feet traveled.

traits.name: Festering Aura (Putrid Only)
traits.descriptionHtml: Any creature, other than you, that starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.
entries: Any creature, other than you, that starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

entries: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel necrotic damage, and the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be frightened of the undead until the end of the target's next turn.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} necrotic damage, and the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be {@condition frightened} of the undead until the end of the target's next turn.

actions.name: Grave Bolt (Skeletal Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Spell Attack: {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 2d4 + 3 + summonSpellLevel necrotic damage.
entries: {@atk rs} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 150 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d4 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} necrotic damage.

actions.name: Rotting Claw (Putrid Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel slashing damage. If the target is poisoned, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} slashing damage. If the target is {@condition poisoned}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Flame Seed
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Weapon Attack: {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 60 ft., one target you can see. Hit: 1d6 + PB fire damage.
entries: {@atk rw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 60 ft., one target you can see. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + PB} fire damage.

actions.name: Fiery Teleportation
actions.descriptionHtml: The spirit and each willing creature of your choice within 5 feet of it teleport up to 15 feet to unoccupied spaces you can see. Then each creature within 5 feet of the space that the spirit left must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC or take 1d6 + PB fire damage.
entries: The spirit and each willing creature of your choice within 5 feet of it teleport up to 15 feet to unoccupied spaces you can see.
